relation Settled #

Upper bounds — holds for every relation

  • \(\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) \le \mathrm{D}(f)\)
    A parity decision tree may branch on $\bigoplus_{i \in S} x_i$ for any $S$; taking $S = \{i\}$ is an ordinary query, so every decision tree is a parity decision tree of the same depth. The simulation never inspects the leaf labels, so it is indifferent to whether the leaves carry a bit, a partial-function value, or one of several valid answers.

The reverse fails badly and in the most familiar way: $\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(\oplus_n) = 1$ while $\mathrm{D}(\oplus_n) = n$.

see also: \(\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f)\), \(\mathrm{D}(f)\) data/relations/13-definitional.yaml

facts: $\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) \ge \tfrac12\log_2 \mathrm{spar}(f)$: a depth-$d$ parity tree has $\le 2^d$ leaves, each the indicator of a coset of a codimension-$\le d$ subspace, whose Fourier support has size $\le 2^d$; so $\mathrm{spar}(f) \le 4^{\,d}$.
Whether the converse $\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) = \mathrm{polylog}\,\mathrm{spar}(f)$ holds -- the log-rank conjecture for parity decision trees -- is a major open problem.
self.name: Parity decision tree complexity
self.short: Decision tree depth when each query may read the parity of an arbitrary subset of bits.

Upper bounds — holds for every total

  • \(\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) = O\big(\sqrt{\mathrm{spar}(f)}\,\log \mathrm{spar}(f)\big)\)
    TsangWongXieZhang13
  • \(\text{(conjectured) } \mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) = \mathrm{polylog}(\mathrm{spar}(f))\)
    TsangWongXieZhang13todo: open
    The query analogue of the log-rank conjecture: composing it with an inner gadget and lifting gives log-rank for XOR functions.

Lower bounds / separations — there is a family achieving this

  • \(\mathrm{spar}(f) \le 4^{\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f)},\ \text{i.e. } \mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f)\ge \tfrac12\log_2\mathrm{spar}(f)\)
    TsangWongXieZhang13

Known unconditionally for special classes: $\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f) = \mathrm{polylog}(\mathrm{spar}(f))$ when $f$ has small $\mathbb{F}_2$-degree, or when $f$ is a "sparse" symmetric function [Sanyal19].

see also: \(\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f)\), \(\mathrm{spar}(f)\), \(\hat{L}_1(f)\), \(\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(f)\), Parity decision trees vs Fourier sparsity (query log-rank) data/relations/05-fourier.yaml
